Why it works

Thymol breaks down the outer cell wall of acne-causing bacteria. Terpineol stops those bacteria building resistance to it. Together they clear active acne, blackheads and whiteheads without stripping the beneficial bacteria your skin needs, which is where broader actives like salicylic acid and benzoyl peroxide tend to cause dryness.

How to use

Take a pea-sized amount and apply to a damp face. Massage in, rinse with lukewarm water and pat dry. Follow with a moisturiser, and sunscreen in the morning. Use twice daily.

Product details

The mechanism, the formula and the routine.

Two actives, one job

Most acne cleansers work by exfoliating or drying out the whole surface of your skin. TT-2 is narrower than that: it goes after the bacteria driving the breakout and leaves everything else alone.

THYMOL
Breaks the outer layer of the bacterial cell so the colony can no longer hold together.
TERPINEOL
Brings down the defence of acne-causing bacteria so they cannot build resistance over repeated use.

What that means on your face

Acne visibly reduces from the third wash. Because the barrier is intact, you do not get the tightness, flaking or rebound oiliness that usually follows an acne wash.

CLINICAL STUDY, 2017
Reduction in acne from Day 3 of twice-daily use.
CONSUMER STUDY, 2024
94% saw clearer skin within one week. 97% had no breakouts after first use.

The four that do the work

THYMOL 0.1%
A botanical extract from thyme with antibiotic properties. The active half of TT-2.
TERPINEOL
Antibacterial, anti-inflammatory and antioxidant. Helps resolve redness, spots and inflammation faster.
NIACINAMIDE
Vitamin B3. Supports the barrier and helps even out post-acne marks.
GLYCERIN
Holds water in the skin so cleansing does not leave it tight.

Questions people ask

If yours is not here, our consumer care team is on 1800-202-4850, 9am to 6pm, seven days a week.

What is TT-2 Technology?

Novology’s patented blend of Thymol and Terpineol. Thymol breaks down the outer cell wall of acne-causing bacteria, while Terpineol stops the bacteria building resistance. Together they clear active acne, blackheads and whiteheads without disturbing the skin’s beneficial microbiome, unlike broader-spectrum actives such as salicylic acid or benzoyl peroxide.

How often should I use this cleanser?

Twice daily, morning and evening. Apply a pea-sized amount to a damp face, massage gently, then rinse with lukewarm water. Follow with a moisturiser and, in the morning, sunscreen.

Is it safe for sensitive skin?

Yes. It is hypoallergenic and formulated to be gentle enough for beginners and for sensitive, acne-prone skin. It cleanses without stripping the natural moisture barrier, so it will not leave sensitive skin feeling tight or irritated.

When will I start seeing results?

Many users notice a reduction in acne in just three washes. In a 2024 consumer study, 94% saw clearer skin within one week.

How is this different from a salicylic acid or benzoyl peroxide face wash?

Those work by broadly exfoliating or drying out the skin, which can disrupt its natural barrier. TT-2 targets only acne-causing bacteria and leaves beneficial bacteria intact, so you get clearer skin without the dryness or irritation that comes with harsher actives.
